title: Determine if Two Strings Are Close
description: Two strings are close if you can transform one to the other using operations: swap any two characters or replace every occurrence of one character with another.
pseudocode:
1. if word1.length != word2.length return false
2. count1 = frequencyMap(word1), count2 = frequencyMap(word2)
3. if set(word1.chars) != set(word2.chars) return false
4. return sorted(count1.values) == sorted(count2.values)
